# Alternatives to Poe

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

Poe's appeal is choice: many models and bots in one app. If you want that with a different pricing model, a native Mac app or an on-device model, these are the alternatives worth a look.

## The options

1. **[ChatNow](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1667518571)** (Tappz): best for the most models, including video. More than 30 models and side-by-side answers; needs iOS 26. *Price (US): AI Plus $6.99, ChatNow Plus $19.99, yearly plans $49.99 to $79.99, credit packs (in-app purchase list); supports Family Sharing; needs iOS 26.*

2. **[Fello AI](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6447705369)** (AI Apps Brewery): best for work on Mac and iPhone. Creates Office files, keeps Projects and syncs between devices. *Price (US): weekly $4.99, monthly $11.99, quarterly $24.99, yearly $89.99 (in-app purchase list); a free tier with limited daily messages.*

3. **[Omnimo](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891)** (made by the team behind this site): best for several makers' models in one chat. GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and more, switchable mid-chat, with Apple Intelligence free on the device and no account. *Price (US): free to start; $6.99 a week (3-day free trial), $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year (1-week free trial). US prices; the app shows the price for your country.*

4. **[Perplexity](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1668000334)** (Perplexity AI): best for research. Answers with sources, with models from several makers behind it. *Price (US): Perplexity Pro $20.00 (also listed at $200.00), Perplexity Max $200.00, credit packs from $5.00 (in-app purchase list).*

5. **[TypingMind](https://www.typingmind.com)** (TypingMind): best for your own API keys. A web interface you buy once; you pay the providers directly. *Price (US): a lifetime license, paid once (price on typingmind.com); you also pay the AI providers for what you use, with your own API keys.*

Ratings, prices and features: each app's US App Store listing and list of in-app purchases, read 25 November 2026. The App Store lists in-app purchases without their billing period; where a listing doesn't say, neither do we.

## How we chose

We list apps we have looked at closely, with what their own listings say. We make Omnimo, so it is on every list; we have tried to say plainly when another app is the better choice.

## Questions

### Is there a Poe alternative without points?

Omnimo counts messages a day instead of points: a few on the free plan, hundreds on Pro. TypingMind has no usage limits of its own: you pay the providers for what you use.

### Which Poe alternative works offline?

Omnimo's Apple Intelligence works offline on supported devices. AllChat's listing also offers on-device models. Apps such as Locally AI and PocketPal run open models fully offline.
